description:
We’re building a simple website that uses NASA’s API to give farmers helpful options, like which crops suit their weather and rainfall, and which crop rotation to follow.

Who can join: Beginners are welcome! We’re a team of learners. It helps if you know any of these, but you can also just come to learn:

HTML, CSS, JavaScript

Working with APIs

Research on crops and farming

Presenting and making the demo video.

Message me to join the team!
summary:
AgriVeya is a climate-smart agriculture platform that helps farmers make better crop rotation decisions using NASA Earth observation data.

It uses climate information such as temperature and rainfall, along with crop characteristics and previous cropping history, to suggest suitable seasonal crop rotations.

AgriVeya aims to make climate data easier to understand and more useful for farmers, helping them plan their crops with changing weather conditions in mind.

Our goal is simple: connect space-based data with real-world farming decisions.
details:
AgriVeya is a web-based agricultural decision-support tool that helps farmers make better crop planning decisions. It uses NASA POWER climate data, location information, soil details, and crop profiles to suggest suitable crops and possible crop rotations.

The project aims to support climate-aware farming, improve crop planning, and encourage sustainable agriculture. It combines NASA Earth observation data with a simple, user-friendly interface and a rule-based recommendation system.

We developed AgriVeya using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, and Express.js, with NASA POWER API for climate data.

Our main focus was to make climate information easier to understand and useful for real farming decisions. We considered location, temperature, rainfall, soil conditions, crop requirements, and sustainability.
